profile: Wingstop is primarily a franchisor of fast-casual chicken restaurants, with independent franchisees operating most locations. Its menu includes cooked-to-order classic and boneless wings, tenders, chicken sandwiches, fries, vegetables, and dips, with dine-in, carryout, and delivery options. The company earns franchise, royalty, and advertising fees and also operates some restaurants. Its customers include restaurant guests and franchisees.
